items.title: Alkenes ki physical khusoosiyat (print mein doosra 11.6.2) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Physical Properties of alkenes, printed as a second 11.6.2 on page 256.

items: Pehle teen members, yani ethene, propene aur butene, room temperature par gases hain; C₅ se C₁₅ tak liquids hain aur is se bare members solids hain.
Yeh pani mein hal nahi hote magar alcohol mein hal ho jate hain.
In ki apni khaas boo hoti hai aur yeh roshan (luminous) shole ke saath jalte hain.
Alkanes ke ulat, sp² hybridization ki wajah se yeh thori polar properties dikhate hain.

blocks.prompt: Ethene roshan shole ke saath kyun jalti hai jabke ethane saaf jalti hai?
blocks.explanation: Ethene mein ethane ke muqable mein carbon zyada aur hydrogen kam hai. Is liye us ka jalna aksar adhoora rehta hai aur bina jale carbon ke chhote zarre shole mein chamakte hain; is se shola roshan aur dhuein wala hota hai.
